evidence: To the extent artificial intelligence and deepfake technologies capabilities improve and are increasingly adopted by threat actors, they may be used to craft increasingly sophisticated cybersecurity attacks against us or the third-party service providers upon which we are dependent.

the cybersecurity processes, technologies and controls that we or our third-party service providers have implemented to secure our systems and electronic information may not be adequate to prevent a disruption or attack

Any unauthorized activities could disrupt our operations or those of our third-party service providers on which we are dependent; result in the misappropriation or compromise of assets or confidential information
ai_positioning.summary: RGLD adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mentionnant principalement les risques de cyberattaques sophistiquées utilisant l'IA et les deepfakes contre ses systèmes et ceux de ses prestataires tiers.
